// tint + a finishing explosion & screenshake).

// A large glowing crescent swings across the whole scene leaving a motion trail;

// doneHook fires at the apex of the (final) sweep.

// =============================================================================

(async () => {

const CFG = {"moveToCenter":true,"centerX":0.5,"centerY":0.5,"dashMs":460,"dashBackMs":520,"ringRx":0.44,"ringRatio":0.3,"ringDropY":0.06,"bandW":120,"trailSpan":2.6,"taperPow":0.75,"coreColor":16774848,"closeFlash":0.85,"emberEveryMs":16,"emberPerBurst":4,"emberSpread":52,"emberMs":440,"flashAlpha":0.95,"flashMs":110,"fadeMs":180,"betweenMs":140,"endPadMs":140,"totalTimeoutMs":12000,"sfxSweep":"Attack3","sfxSweepVol":0.6,"name":"Elemental Slash (Enchanted)","key":"asura-elemental-slash-ench","color":16769613,"sweeps":2,"sweepMs":600,"explosion":false};

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Sweep][" + CFG.name + "]";

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.dungeon." + CFG.key;

const EXPLOSION_URL = "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Explosion/Explosion_01_Orange_400x400.webm";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

// Asura: the sweep takes the colour of the Aspect it is currently holding.

// Resolved OUTER-side (this runs on the GM, which has the actor) and shipped

// in the broadcast CFG, so every client draws the same colour.

try {

const ASPECT_COLORS = { fire: 0xff8a3d, bolt: 0xb46bff, ice: 0x8fe2ff, air: 0xc6ffe4 };

for (const e of (sourceToken?.actor?.effects ?? [])) {

if (e?.disabled) continue;

const m = /^\s*(fire|bolt|ice|air)\s+aspect\s*$/i.exec(String(e?.name ?? ''));

} catch (_) {}

const doneHook = "oni.anim." + ANIM_KEY + "." + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

function emitLocal(name, data) { try { Hooks.callAll(name, data); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const A = ctx.params.assets;

const stage = canvas.stage;

stage.sortableChildren = true;

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;

const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;

const WT = stage.worldTransform.clone();

const ZOOM = Math.abs(stage.scale?.x || 1) || 1;

const S2W = (fx, fy) => WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(fx * W, fy * H));

const wLen = (px) => px / ZOOM;

const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Number(ms) || 0));

const spawned = [];

function destroyObj(o) { try { if (o && !o._destroyed) { if (o.parent) o.parent.removeChild(o); o.destroy({ children: true }); } } catch (_) {} }

let doneFired = false;

function fireDone(res) { if (doneFired) return; doneFired = true; try { Hooks.callAll(ctx.params.doneHook, res || { ok: true }); } catch (_) {} }

const easeOutCubic = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

// token sprite clone + hide/restore (caster physically moves to center)

function meshOf(tok) { return tok ? tok.mesh : null; }

function makeSprite(tok, faceSign) {

const m = meshOf(tok);

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(m?.texture ?? PIXI.Texture.WHITE);

sp.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5);

sp.width = Math.abs(m?.width ?? (tok?.w ?? 100));

sp.height = Math.abs(m?.height ?? (tok?.h ?? 100));

const guard = () => { if (!tok) return; tok.renderable = false; if (m) m.renderable = false; };

return { start(){ if(!tok||on)return; on=true; tR=tok.renderable??true; mR=m?.renderable??true; ticker.add(guard); },

function dotTexture(hex) {

const s = 64; const cv = document.createElement("canvas"); cv.width = cv.height = s;

const g = cv.getContext("2d");

const col = "#" + (hex >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(6, "0").slice(-6);

const grd = g.createRadialGradient(s/2, s/2, 0, s/2, s/2, s/2);

grd.addColorStop(0, "#ffffff"); grd.addColorStop(0.4, col); grd.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");

// A point on the perspective ground-ellipse (wide rx, short ry = tilt).

function ellipsePt(cx, cy, rx, ry, a) { return { x: cx + rx*Math.cos(a), y: cy + ry*Math.sin(a) }; }

// Redraw the sweep as a BLADED SLASH TRAIL following the ellipse: a filled

// ribbon that tapers from a sharp point at the tail to full width at the head,

// with a crisp bright OUTER edge (the cutting edge). The far half of the oval

// (top, sin<0) is dimmed so it reads as receding behind the arena.

// headA = leading-edge angle; trailSpan = arc length of the visible trail.

function drawRingSlash(g, cx, cy, rx, ry, headA, trailSpan, bandW, gold, cream, alpha, taperPow, shimmerColor, shimmer) {

g.clear();

const steps = Math.max(10, Math.round(trailSpan / (Math.PI*2) * 120));

const tailA = headA - trailSpan;

for (let i=0;i<=steps;i++){

const t = i/steps; // 0 at tail -> 1 at head

const a = tailA + trailSpan*t;

const w = bandW * Math.pow(t, taperPow ?? 0.7); // taper to a sharp point at the tail

const inRx = Math.max(1, rx - w), inRy = Math.max(1, ry - w*(ry/rx));

}

const sh = 0.5 + 0.5*(shimmer ?? 1);

for (let i=1;i<=steps;i++){

const d = (dep[i-1]+dep[i])/2, tt = (wt[i-1]+wt[i])/2;

const mx = (outer[i-1].x+inner[i-1].x)/2, my = (outer[i-1].y+inner[i-1].y)/2;

const nx = (outer[i].x+inner[i].x)/2, ny = (outer[i].y+inner[i].y)/2;

g.lineStyle({ width: bandW*1.7*tt + bandW*0.5, color: shimmerColor, alpha: alpha*(0.10+0.32*sh)*(0.3+0.7*d)*tt, cap: "round", join: "round" });

g.lineTo(inner[i].x, inner[i].y); g.lineTo(inner[i-1].x, inner[i-1].y);

g.closePath(); g.endFill();

}

// crisp bright cutting edge along the OUTER arc (sharp, butt/miter — no round cap)

for (let i=1;i<=steps;i++){

const d = (dep[i-1]+dep[i])/2, tt = (wt[i-1]+wt[i])/2;

g.lineStyle({ width: Math.max(1.5, bandW*0.12*tt), color: cream, alpha: alpha*(0.45+0.55*d)*tt, cap: "butt", join: "miter" });

let casterHide = null;

}

const dotTex = dotTexture(cream);

sp.anchor.set(0.5); sp.zIndex = 8806; sp.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

const rr = Math.random();

function centroid(list) {

if (!list.length) return home;

let x = 0, y = 0;

for (const t of list) { const c = ctr(t); x += c.x; y += c.y; }

return { x: x / list.length, y: y / list.length };

}

// Centre of the authored play area (the v2 conflict scene stage rect).

// A pull-back should frame the arena, so it wants a FIXED point: aiming at

// the caster turns a zoom-out into a pan, and aiming at a centroid makes the

// framing drift with wherever the combatants happen to be standing.

function stageCentre() {

const f = canvas.scene && canvas.scene.flags ? canvas.scene.flags['fabula-ultima-companion'] : null;

const sr = f && f.conflict ? f.conflict.stage : null;

if (sr) return { x: sr.x + sr.w / 2, y: sr.y + sr.h / 2 };

return centroid(tgts.concat(caster ? [caster] : []));

}

function playSfx(k, v) { if (!cfg[k]) return; oni.sfx(cfg[k], { volume: cfg[v] == null ? 0.6 : cfg[v], fadeAfter: cfg[k + 'Fade'] || 0, fadeMs: cfg[k + 'FadeMs'] || 400 }); }

async function fxWebm(url, x, y, o) {

if (!url) return null;

o = o || {};

return oni.webm(url, { size: o.size || S.wLen(320), x: x, y: y, angle: o.angle || 0,

alpha: o.alpha == null ? 1 : o.alpha, zIndex: o.z || 95000, parent: o.parent || null });

}

async function fxBeam(url, from, to, o) {

if (!url) return null;

o = o || {};

const dist = Math.hypot(to.x - from.x, to.y - from.y);

const ang = Math.atan2(to.y - from.y, to.x - from.x);

const r = await oni.webm(url, { size: dist, x: from.x, y: from.y, parent: o.parent || null, zIndex: o.z || 95000 });

if (!r || !r.sprite) return null;

const sp = r.sprite;

sp.anchor.set(0, 0.5);

sp.width = dist * (o.lengthScale || 1);

sp.height = dist * (o.thickness || 0.25);

sp.position.set(from.x, from.y);

sp.rotation = ang;

return r;

}

let fired = false;

function done() { if (fired) return; fired = true; oni.fireDone(); }

async function shakeTarget(t, ms, amp) {

if (!t) return;

const spr = oni.cloneToken(t);

if (!spr) return;

const restore = oni.hideToken(t);

const c = ctr(t);

await oni.tween({ from: 0, to: 1, duration: ms, ease: E.linear, onUpdate: (v) => {

const decay = 1 - v;

spr.position.set(c.x + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * amp * decay, c.y + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * amp * decay);

} });

spr.position.set(c.x, c.y);

restore();

try { spr.destroy(); } catch (e) {}

}

function streak(x1, y1, x2, y2, color, width, host) {

const g = new PIXI.Graphics();

g.lineStyle({ width: width, color: color, alpha: 1, cap: 'round' });

g.moveTo(x1, y1); g.lineTo(x2, y2);

g.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

(host || canvas.stage).addChild(g);

return g;

}

if (!caster) { done(); return; }

const host = oni.layer({ zIndex: 93000 });

const spots = cfg.at === 'targets' && tgts.length ? tgts.map(ctr) : [home];

playSfx('sfx', 'sfxVol');

if (cfg.gatherMs > 0) {

await Promise.all(spots.map((p) => oni.particles({ x: p.x, y: p.y,

count: cfg.gatherCount, color: cfg.color, size: 12,

radius: S.wLen(cfg.gatherRadius), life: cfg.gatherMs, mode: 'gather',

blend: PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD, parent: host, ease: E.inQuad })));

}

if (cfg.flash) oni.domFlash({ color: cfg.flashColor, alpha: cfg.flashAlpha, fadeIn: 120, hold: 60, fadeOut: 380 });

if (cfg.screenshakeMs > 0) oni.screenshake({ duration: cfg.screenshakeMs, intensity: cfg.screenshakeAmp });

const rings = [];

if (cfg.ring) {

for (const p of spots) {

const g = new PIXI.Graphics();

g.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

host.addChild(g);

const col = cfg.ringColor == null ? cfg.color : cfg.ringColor;

rings.push(oni.tween({ from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.ringMs, ease: E.outQuad, onUpdate: (v) => {

g.clear();

g.lineStyle({ width: S.wLen(cfg.ringWidth) * (1 - v * 0.6), color: col, alpha: 1 - v });

g.drawCircle(p.x, p.y, S.wLen(cfg.ringRadius) * v);

}, onComplete: () => { try { g.destroy(); } catch (e) {} } }));

}

}

// Needles fly from the CASTER regardless of where the burst lands — the

// quills come off the creature, not off the people they hit.

const needles = [];

if (cfg.needles > 0) {

const ncol = cfg.needleColor == null ? cfg.color : cfg.needleColor;

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.needles; i++) {

const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;

const reach = S.wLen(cfg.needleReach) * (0.45 + Math.random() * 0.85);

const len = S.wLen(cfg.needleLen) * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.7);

const g = new PIXI.Graphics();

g.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

host.addChild(g);

needles.push(oni.tween({ from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.needleMs * (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.6), ease: E.outQuad, onUpdate: (v) => {

const hx = home.x + Math.cos(a) * reach * v, hy = home.y + Math.sin(a) * reach * v;

g.clear();

g.lineStyle({ width: S.wLen(cfg.needleWidth) * (1 - v * 0.5), color: ncol, alpha: 1 - v * 0.85, cap: 'round' });

g.moveTo(hx - Math.cos(a) * len, hy - Math.sin(a) * len);

g.lineTo(hx, hy);

}, onComplete: () => { try { g.destroy(); } catch (e) {} } }));

}

}

const bursts = spots.map((p) => oni.particles({ x: p.x, y: p.y,

count: cfg.count, color: cfg.color, size: cfg.size,

radius: S.wLen(cfg.radius), life: cfg.life,

blend: PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD, parent: host }));

const shakes = [];

if (cfg.shake && cfg.shakeMs > 0) for (const tk of tgts) shakes.push(shakeTarget(tk, cfg.shakeMs, S.wLen(cfg.shakeAmp)));

if (cfg.donePhase === 'impact') done();

await Promise.all(rings.concat(bursts, shakes, needles));

done();

`;

try {

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null });

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 15000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG, assets: ASSETS },

meta: { source: "Sword Enchant - Fire" },

});

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now() });

}

})();
